market_outlook.short_term: Markets likely volatile in 1-3 month window. Fed rate hike creates headwinds but oil-driven inflation may moderate. $7T options day signals positioning risk. Tech rally may extend but AI governance concerns (OpenAI model issues) could trigger sharp corrections. Yen/dollar dynamics add FX volatility. Gas prices near highs create consumer pressure ahead of midterms.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive but uneven. AI capex cycle (US-China rivalry) supports tech infrastructure. Housing remains structurally challenged. Buffett succession may shift Berkshire strategy. India growth test and global infrastructure spending offer emerging-market opportunities. Credit tightening may persist, favoring quality over yield-chasing.
